Packed shredcap slice and bank hash message formats with validation helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines packed message formats for shred capture data used by the replay and repair flow. It declares `fd_shredcap_slice_header_msg_t` and `fd_shredcap_slice_trailer_msg_t` for slice framing, and `fd_shredcap_bank_hash_msg_t` for recording bank hashes with their slot number. Each format includes a magic value and version field, and the inline validation functions [`fd_shredcap_slice_header_validate`](<#fd_shredcap_slice_header_validate>), [`fd_shredcap_slice_trailer_validate`](<#fd_shredcap_slice_trailer_validate>), and [`fd_shredcap_bank_hash_msg_validate`](<#fd_shredcap_bank_hash_msg_validate>) stop the program if the data does not match the expected format. The file also defines footprint macros for each message type and includes the runtime and custom type headers needed for `ulong` and `fd_hash_t`.
